notes: The seed URL https://www.stonewallcounty.org/page/stonewall.Elections works (the page was already in the shared cache). No Clarity site (elections.json 404). Results are scanned or SOS PDFs; server Last-Modified values differ by file, so upload times are usable. Scan file names (skm_c300iYYMMDDHHMM) give the scan date. No runoff results are posted. Check 3 pending for the runoff (wayback-data branch not found on origin).
tag_rationale: The 2024 general and 2026 primary are LATER by check 2 (county totals uploaded the next day, precinct numbers only in official reports), so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS; confidence low because no upload is on election night.

2024_general.fact: 'Unofficial General Election Results' = SOS 'Election Unofficial Results Report 2024 NOVEMBER 5TH GENERAL ELECTION November 05, 2024 STONEWALL County' (county totals by vote method); PDF CreationDate Wed Nov 6 02:05:46 2024 UTC (8:05 PM CST), Last-Modified Wed, 06 Nov 2024 17:26:35 GMT (11:26 AM CST Nov 6). The only other 2024 results file is 'November 5th Election Official Results' (scan dated 2024-11-12 by file name). No unofficial precinct numbers were posted.

2026_primary.fact: 'Election Results' (skm_c300i26030411110.pdf, 19-page scan) = Electionware 'Summary Results Report TX Stonewall County 260303 Primary 6110 March 3, 2026 UNOFFICIAL RESULTS' (county totals), footer 'Election Summary - 03/03/2026 9:28 PM'; Last-Modified Wed, 04 Mar 2026 18:00:53 GMT (12:00 PM CST Mar 4). Precinct numbers only in 'Precinct by Precinct Official Results' (scan dated 2026-03-19 by file name).

2026_runoff.fact: The runoff items on the Elections page are notices, sample ballots and post-election hand count notices; no results files. Check 3 pending.
